title: Add Jornal Bitcoin to business
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [Jornal Bitcoin](https://jornalbitcoin.com.br) to business
- A real-time Brazilian Portuguese cryptocurrency news aggregator that automatically curates, translates, and summarizes articles using Pollinations text models (Gemma & OpenAI) and generates custom cov

Fixes #11741
